$comment: A clock_gen (1 kHz, 50 % duty, 0 to 5 V) on the clock of a 74LS161 that is enabled and neither cleared nor loaded.
By hand: the clock is HIGH for the first half of each 1 ms period, so it is high at load and rises again at t = 1 ms, 2 ms, 3 ms and so on.

Both engines take a clock that is already high at the first evaluation as a rising edge (the counter's clock memory starts LOW: core/spec/w1-classic-semantics.md, 'Initial edges'), so the counter reads 1 from load.
It adds one on each later rising edge, so between edges its count is (1 + floor(t / 1 ms)) mod 16.
At the harness's four samples (0, 5.3, 10.6 and 21.2 ms) that is 1, 6, 11 and 22 mod 16 = 6, with the clock high, high, low and high.
RCO is high only at count 15, from 14 ms to 15 ms.
The digital check reads the count just before each falling edge of the clock and lines the two engines up on a count of 1.
test/core/promoted-kinds-fixtures.test.ts checks these values on both engines.
